name: Radio
description:
One option of a RadioGroup. The chosen circle fills with the accent around a dot.
Each option is its own Field item, so inside a Field every radio keeps its own id and name.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ label, description, className, disabled, id, ...rest }: RadioProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: description
props.description: Additional content describing the value, state, or consequence.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select the radio button.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique identifying value of the radio in a group.
